meta.name: pr-lens
meta.description: WHAT: Draws a code change or part of a codebase as an animated architecture or data-flow diagram, on its own or in a pull request. WHEN: asked to diagram, visualise or explain a change or a system, or when a pull request should carry a diagram. KEYWORDS: PR Lens, diagram, architecture, data flow, visualise, visualize, pull request

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把代码改动画成动态架构图,让评审一眼看懂
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果每次看改动都要花很久弄清它到底动了哪里
copy.tagline_en: Turn code changes into animated architecture diagrams
copy.fit_line_en: For you if figuring out what a change actually did takes forever

howto.what: 它把一次代码改动或代码库的某部分写成一份图形文档，渲染成带动画的架构图或数据流图，然后把画布链接给你，或把图附到 PR 描述、评论里。
howto.when: 当你要求把某个改动或系统画成图、讲清楚，或提到 PR Lens、架构图、数据流图等关键词，又或者要求 PR 带上图时触发。

say.text: 把这个分支的改动画成架构图，给我画布链接
say.note: 渲染后推送画布，返回可分享链接

say.text: 给这个 PR 附上改动前后的数据流图
say.note: 图片上传后写进 PR 描述

say.text: 展开讲讲图上 send-pipeline 这条流程
say.note: 画布上逐步播放并高亮所指节点

howto.what_en: It turns a code change or part of a codebase into one graph document, renders it as animated architecture or data-flow SVGs, then hands you a canvas link or attaches the diagrams to a PR description or comment.
howto.when_en: Use it when you ask to diagram or explain a change or a system, mention PR Lens, architecture or data flow, or want a pull request to carry a diagram.

say_en.text: Diagram this branch's changes as an architecture view and give me the canvas link
say_en.note: Renders, pushes a canvas, returns a share link

say_en.text: Attach the data-flow diagram to this pull request
say_en.note: Uploads the SVG into the PR description

say_en.text: Walk me through the send-pipeline flow on the canvas
say_en.note: Plays the answer step by step on the canvas
